children: Canaccord Genuity maintained their Hold rating on Tilray Brands's stock with a price target of $4.00.
The price target implies an upside of 11.4% from the Oct 8 close of $3.59.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Tilray Brands reported a revenue of $257.1 million, falling short of the consensus estimate of $266.3 million, primarily due to challenges in the cannabis segment and pricing pressures in the international market, leading to a cautious outlook.

: Despite the overall revenue miss, BrewDog significantly contributed $55.9 million to the beverage segment, showcasing strong year-over-year growth, which provided some optimism amidst the struggles of legacy beer brands.
